[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:381YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<ic> To create the title of Weigher of Worth, a reliquary in the mountains of Gildermark to take the form of a mana sinecure in Skarsind, to be appointed by the Senator of Skarsind. The title is revocable by the Imperial Orc National Assembly. To be made using 10 wains of Mithril. <br><br>
<i>Announced by Azzam i Zaydan i Requeza.</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This sinecure was announced by a holder of an Imperial Wayleave, using the legal power to commission constructions delegated to them by the Senate.

===Date===
* Summer 381YE

===Progress===
* 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns provided by Azzam i Zaydan i Riqueza after Summer Solstice 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* This sinecure is now complete, and automatically created the title [[Weigher of Worth]].
